name: EFF-FF-v2-diagnostic
claim: Input-reference cut-interface ligand geometry plus normalized cut-bond torsions, heavy-atom soft-core UFF-style Lennard-Jones, and a compact vdW-radius protein-ligand steric barrier. Element coverage includes every element observed in the frozen S50 confidence train/validation ligand cohort; no AMBER, GAFF, OpenFF, UFF, or MMFF compatibility claim.

functional_form.nonbonded: switch(r) * uff_d_ij * ((uff_x_ij / sqrt(r^2 + softcore^2))^12 - 2 * (uff_x_ij / sqrt(r^2 + softcore^2))^6)
functional_form.protein_ligand_steric_barrier: 0.5 * steric_k * (steric_tau * softplus((steric_radius_scale * (vdw_i + vdw_j) - r) / steric_tau))^2 * compact_quintic_switch(r; safe_distance, safe_distance + steric_cutoff_margin)
functional_form.mixing: uff_x_ij = sqrt(uff_x_i * uff_x_j); uff_d_ij = sqrt(uff_d_i * uff_d_j)
functional_form.switch: quintic smoothstep from switch_distance_angstrom to cutoff_angstrom

provenance.nonbonded_form: UFF 12-6 form and published element-level x/D constants
provenance.nonbonded_reference: Rappe et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1992, DOI 10.1021/ja00051a040
provenance.vdw_radii: Bondi radii for the original main-group elements, with the Bondi-compatible Mantina et al. value for B. The S50 cohort extension copies RDKit periodic-table vdW radii for elements without an original table entry. Every value is frozen here so runtime parameterization does not depend on RDKit lookup behavior.
vdw_radius_references: Mantina et al., J. Phys. Chem. A 2009, DOI 10.1021/jp8111556
RDKit PeriodicTable::getRvdw values copied during the EFF-FF 2.2 cohort extension
provenance.cohort_element_extension: Atomic numbers observed in all 44,127 eligible records of the frozen S50 confidence train/validation input manifest (SHA-256 6a991e964715f9ddb51ce48ccbea5a948eb3b2d3c51de1f26929389365aec5f3). UFF x/D constants follow Rappe et al.; atomic masses and extension vdW radii are frozen periodic-table values.
provenance.steric_barrier_status: Default-on diagnostic guard. Radius scale and force constant are initial internal hypotheses that require PLINDER calibration before production admission; Astex and PoseBusters must not tune them.
provenance.bonded_parameters: EFF-Dock input-reference cut-interface restraints and generic normalized torsion constants; compatibility with an external force field is not claimed
provenance.input_reference: Sanitized production-inference ligand conformer; bond lengths and angles only. Crystal coordinates are used only when a crystal file is itself supplied to diagnostic trace, never as a hidden inference target.
